description: Asks when a field validation rule ([V] > 0) rejects a proposed value on a dynaset Edit. With ValidateOnSet True: Value put of -1, then Value and EditMode read, then a valid put and Update. With ValidateOnSet False: an invalid put, Value and EditMode, Update, Value and EditMode again, then CancelUpdate. Then which of two invalid fields (V and W, both ruled > 0) is reported, with the assignment order swapped. DBEngine.Errors is read after each step. The fixture is a writable copy. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
